description:
Welcome to The Safety Desk where we investigate the warning signs behind workplace accidents, near misses and dangerous incidents.

Through animated reconstructions, incident analysis and practical safety insight, we examine what happened, what went wrong, what could have prevented it, and the lessons we can learn.

From construction and manufacturing to warehouses, fire safety, machinery, work at height and major incidents, The Safety Desk turns real-world safety lessons into engaging stories that inform, educate and protect.

🔎 Incidents investigated
⚠️ Risks uncovered
🛡️ Lessons learned
👥 Lives protected

The warning signs were already there

Subscribe to @TheSafetyDeskLive and join us at The Safety Desk.

*Content is provided for education and general awareness and should not be treated as site-specific health and safety advice.*
